title: The importance and power of truth
intro: Truth leads to goodness, and goodness leads to Jannah.

learn.html: To understand how important the truth is, we first need to know that sincerity is the quality that leads us to the truth. Truth is very important in everyone’s life, and especially in the life of a believer.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah tells the believers to be mindful of Him and to be with those who are truthful. <small>(Qur’an, At-Tawbah 9:119)</small>
Allah revealed the Qur’an to us, and everything in it is true. Our Prophet Muhammad (SAW) followed the Truth that was revealed, and he himself always spoke only the truth.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: Once the Prophet (SAW) pointed to his mouth and said: “By the One in whose Hand is my life, only truth comes out of it.” (Abu Dawud)

It is the duty of every Muslim to tell the truth, because it leads to goodness, and goodness leads to Jannah. Our parents, our muallims and our teachers teach us to love the truth, to always tell it, and to show it with our deeds.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “Tell the truth, for truth leads to goodness, and goodness leads to Jannah.” (Bukhari)
People who love the truth tell it even when it is against them. Muhammad (SAW) said: “Say the truth, even if it is bitter.” (Ahmad)

learn.title: Adam (AS)
learn.html: While he was in Jannah, Adam (AS) made a mistake. Because he loved the truth, he admitted his mistake – and because of that, Allah, the Most High, forgave his sin.

learn.title: Ka‘b ibn Malik (RA)
learn.html: The companion Ka‘b ibn Malik told Muhammad (SAW) the truth about a mistake he had made. The Prophet (SAW) made him happy with the news that Allah had forgiven him. Then Ka‘b said: “O Messenger of Allah, Allah saved me because I told the truth. As a sign of my repentance, for as long as I live I will speak only the truth.”

learn.title: 💬 Talk with your muallim
learn.html: A saying: “Lies have short legs!” – a lie can’t run far; sooner or later the truth catches up with it. What does this saying mean to you?

practice.title: Who said it?
pairs: “Tell the truth, for truth leads to goodness…”
“Say the truth, even if it is bitter.”
Be mindful of Allah and be with the truthful
“Allah saved me because I told the truth.”

practice.title: Where does truth lead?
practice.prompt: Put the steps in order, as in the hadith.

items.text: I broke the vase and told Mum straight away.
I said sorry and admitted my mistake to my teacher.
I told the truth even though I knew I’d get in trouble.
I said my brother did it, but it was me.
I said I’d done my homework when I hadn’t.

questions.q: Which quality leads us to the truth?
What did Adam (AS) do after his mistake in Jannah?
options: He admitted it, and Allah forgave him

questions.q: What did Ka‘b ibn Malik promise after Allah forgave him?
options: To speak only the truth as long as he lived

questions.q: Who teaches us to love and tell the truth?
